title: $500 game jam this week, theme is "take a walk,"  build for free on Bash.tv
author: mellamofionaa
selftext:
Game Jam: Take a walk

hey! i help run community stuff for [bash.tv](http://bash.tv), a vibe coding platform where you build games, apps, and art experiences with others in real time. coming to you from the creator of Vine Dom Hofmann and a seasoned game designer/producer Chris Supino. we're doing a little jam this week.

the theme is take a walk. go outside, notice something, a scene, a sound, that one weird thing on the sidewalk, and build it into a bash. game, visual novel, app, art experience, whatever it wants to be. the only hard rule is it has to include at least one original thing you made, art or audio.

the basics:

* $500 prize pool, split across 1st ($300), 2nd ($100), 3rd ($100)
* projects due fri aug 28, 9AM PT
* demo day that same day, 3PM PT / 6PM ET
* you can ask us for more credit if you need for building
* build solo or with a group, all skill levels welcome
* build on [bash.tv](http://bash.tv)

if you want in, here's the info: [https://app.notion.com/p/Bash-Bounty-Take-a-Walk-3b9bbd3cecd981dbb9b2ff0cc9b591f2?source=copy\_link](https://app.notion.com/p/Bash-Bounty-Take-a-Walk-3b9bbd3cecd981dbb9b2ff0cc9b591f2?source=copy_link)

sorry mods if this breaks any rules! please let me know.
